name: billing
description: You can use the Billing API to programatically list the billing views available to you for a given time period.

subcommands.name: associate-source-views
subcommands.description: Associates one or more source billing views with an existing billing view.

subcommands.name: create-billing-view
subcommands.description: Creates a billing view with the specified billing view attributes.

subcommands.name: delete-billing-view
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified billing view.

subcommands.name: disassociate-source-views
subcommands.description: Removes the association between one or more source billing views and an existing billing view.

subcommands.name: get-billing-preferences
subcommands.description: Retrieves billing preferences for the specified feature.

subcommands.name: get-billing-view
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata associated to the specified billing view ARN.

subcommands.name: get-credit-allocation-history
subcommands.description: Returns the per-billing-month allocation history for credits applied to an Amazon Web Services account's bills.

subcommands.name: get-credits
subcommands.description: Returns the list of Amazon Web Services account credits for the specified account.

subcommands.name: get-enterprise-support-charge-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of Enterprise Support data aggregated across all accounts in the Enterprise Support profile.

subcommands.name: get-enterprise-support-contract-details
subcommands.description: Returns Enterprise Support contract details.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the resource-based policy document attached to the resource in JSON format.

subcommands.name: list-billing-views
subcommands.description: Lists the billing views available for a given time period.

subcommands.name: list-enterprise-support-linked-account-charges
subcommands.description: Returns Support-eligible spend broken down at linked account level.

subcommands.name: list-source-views-for-billing-view
subcommands.description: Lists the source views (managed Amazon Web Services billing views) associated with the billing view.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags associated with the billing view resource.

subcommands.name: redeem-credits
subcommands.description: Redeems an Amazon Web Services promotional credit code on behalf of the calling account.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: An API operation for adding one or more tags (key-value pairs) to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-billing-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates billing preferences for the specified feature.

subcommands.name: update-billing-view
subcommands.description: An API to update the attributes of the billing view.
